title: Kimi K3.1 Pro on two RTX PRO 6000: long prompts read layer by layer
model: Kimi K3.1 Pro: 2.8T MoE, 92 MoE layers, 896 experts per layer, 16 routed per token; Q8_0 spine, MXFP4 experts (82,432 files, 1.45 TB)
hardware: two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB each), an 87 GiB VM with a 56 GiB pinned expert pool, four NVMe devices

settings.common: one fresh process per run, greedy (--temp 0), raw prompts, --ssd-streaming --ssd-streaming-cold --ssd-streaming-cache-experts 16, DS4_K3_DSA with the indexer file, a cache of 16,384 (13,087-token prompt) or 24,576 positions (21,873-token prompt)
settings.two_cards: DS4_CUDA_STREAM_SPLIT=46 with --gpu-devices 0,1 --gpu-vram auto, DS4_K3_TP=1 DS4_K3_SMCOPY=1, DS4_K3_CACHE_POLICY=decay-device DS4_K3_CACHE_DECAY=0.95
settings.25_november: DS4_K3_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR=1 DS4_K3_TP_SHARED=1 DS4_K3_TP_ATTN=1 DS4_K3_EXPERT_SPLIT=1 on top of the two-card settings
